title: FoxFighter's Create Modpack
description: A Create focused 1.20.1 modpack with overhauled terrain and good performance.
body:
This modpack includes overhauled terrain, shader support + Distant Horizons, controller support, improved performance and enhanced quality of life.

It focuses on Create 5.1 and Ad Astra for tech/progression.

(This modpack is primarily for personal use)
